feeds.title: Endometriosis UK News
feeds.description: Endometriosis UK is here to provide support, information and a community for people affected by endometriosis. Our goal is to improve the lives of people affected by endometriosis and work towards a future where it has the least possible impact on those living with the condition.

feeds.title: Endo Mom
feeds.description: I am a wife and stay at home mom. I have been married for 8.5 years. My husband and I currently have three biological children. In 2009, I was diagnosed with Stage 1 Endometriosis by laparoscopy. In 2017, I was diagnosed with hyperthyroidism (Graves' Disease). Follow my journey through endometriosis.

feeds.title: Endometriosis Association QLD Blog
feeds.description: The Endometriosis Association (Qld) Inc. aims to provide education, information and support to women affected by endometriosis in Australia. We also work closely with research facilities and organisations.

feeds.title: Seckin Endometriosis Center Blog
feeds.description: The blog features articles that have to do exclusively with Endometriosis and Pelvic Pain. Dr. Seckin is a world-renowned, advanced gynecologic surgeon with over 30 years of experience in the world-class treatment of Endometriosis excision surgery in NYC.

feeds.title: Endo Black Blog
feeds.description: ENDO Black's mission is to raise awareness about Endometriosis among African American women and to create an atmosphere of support, sisterly love, and education around the topic of women's reproductive health.

feeds.title: The Guardian » Endometriosis
feeds.description: Latest Endometriosis news from the Guardian, the world's leading liberal voice.

feeds.title: Endometriosis News
feeds.description: Endometriosis is a pervasive condition that has a major impact on women's health. It is estimated that 10-15% of all women suffer from endometriosis, and yet news coverage of the condition, as well as a science, research and treatment breakthroughs, are still lacking online. Endometriosis News seeks to fill this news gap by offering daily digital coverage of the latest findings and breakthroughs.

feeds.title: Peace With Endo
feeds.description: Aubree Deimler is an author, speaker and integrative health coach who helps women with endometriosis naturally manage pain, increase energy and find peace with endo.

feeds.title: Bloomin' Uterus
feeds.description: My name is Lisa. I was diagnosed with Endometriosis in June of 2014 and immediately searched for ways to cope. I started a fundraiser for the Endometriosis Foundation of America, then I created my blog to continue to spread awareness and find/offer support to my fellow EndoSisters.

feeds.title: World Endometriosis Society
feeds.description: The World Endometriosis Society (WES) advances evidence-based standards and innovations for education, advocacy, clinical care, and research in endometriosis and related disorders, in collaboration with its stakeholders and global partners to improve the lives of all affected women and their families.

feeds.title: EndoActive Blog
feeds.description: EndoActive is a health promotion charity raising Awareness of Endometriosis, Advocating for women and girls with Endo and providing Information.

feeds.title: Endohope
feeds.description: My name is Michelle. I'm 32 years old and I live in the UK. I've lived with endometriosis for eight years now. Like many women with endo, I suffered with extremely painful periods (silently and not-so-silently) for over a decade. In this blog you will find articles for How I live and work with Endometriosis. Positive discussion and advice about managing endometriosis and the problems it causes.

feeds.title: Robert B. Albee
feeds.description: Robert B. Albee, Jr., MD, FACOG, ACGE is internationally renowned as one of the world's foremost pioneers in Laparoscopic Excision of endometriosis (LAPEX).

feeds.title: Endometriosis Association of Ireland
feeds.description: The Endometriosis Association of Ireland was formed in 1987, to provide information and support for women with endometriosis. The association is run on a voluntary basis, mostly by women who have endometriosis themselves.

feeds.title: Surviving Endometriosis
feeds.description: I'm a woman. It doesn't define who I am, but it shapes my experiences. This is a story of my journey to surviving endometriosis.

feeds.title: A journey to a better me
feeds.description: Hey I'm Ali. This blog is on Weightloss and struggling with endometriosis.. also my favourite recipes and so much more. There's so much more to endometriosis than meets the eye. This is my motivation page, ups and downs, living with chronic pelvic pain.

feeds.title: My Endometriosis Diary
feeds.description: The mission of this blog is to raise awareness about endometriosis. Stories, recipes, reviews, health & beauty tips. All given by a woman who has the condition. It affects 176 million women worldwide. It takes years for women to be diagnosed. Detailing various subjects revolving around the disease and how to cope with it.

feeds.title: Endometriosis
feeds.description: I'm Shireen, a thirty something mama bear to a very special little ivf miracle and better half to my partner in crime, Daniel. This blog is all about my topsy turvy life with endometriosis, fibromyalgia and borderline osteoporosis. I hope you find it helps in your own journeys. ♥

feeds.title: Still Sunflowers
feeds.description: A twenty-something shares her experience with endometriosis - a painful condition affecting millions of women. This blog is about one woman's journey with the painful, incurable condition of endometriois

feeds.title: The Chronic Caper
feeds.description: Learning to live with endometriosis (diagnosed March 2012), trying to spread awareness while indulging in my other passion - vintage clothing!

feeds.title: Endometriosis.org
feeds.description: The global forum for news and information in endometriosis providing all stakeholders with facts about the disease.

feeds.title: Kofinas Fertility » Endometriosis
feeds.description: Get news and information on Endometriosis. Kofinas Fertility Group is a New York fertility clinic that provides infertility services and fertility treatments to men and women in the tri-state area.

feeds.title: Endometriosis Australia Blog
feeds.description: Endometriosis Australia, a national charity endeavours, to increase recognition of endometriosis, provide education programs, and provide funding for research.

feeds.title: Endometriosis Support & Advocacy Services
feeds.description: Endometriosis Support and Advocacy Services aim to be a leading social work based non-profit dedicated to providing endometriosis patients with support and resources.

feeds.title: ReceptivaDx Blog
feeds.description: ReceptivaDx is a new advancement in the detection of endometriosis in women with unexplained infertility.

feeds.title: iCareBetter » Endometriosis
feeds.description: This section features articles on Endometriosis. iCareBetter is an innovative platform dedicated to helping patients with endometriosis find compassionate and skilled experts.

feeds.title: Endometriosis South Coast Blog
feeds.description: Blog posts spanning a range of subjects related to Endometriosis and Adenomyosis. Endometriosis South Coast is an inclusive charity set up to help people along the South Coast who are going through the diagnosis stages of Endometriosis and Adenomyosis or have been diagnosed with the conditions.
